items.source: This default method delegates to the original convertToReadResourceResult(Object, String, String, ContentType) to ensure backwards compatibility with existing custom implementations.

items.source: This interface defines a contract for converting various return types from resource methods to a standardized McpSchema.ReadResourceResult format.
items.translation: 该接口定义了将资源方法的多种返回类型转换为标准化 `McpSchema.ReadResourceResult` 格式的契约。

items.source: This method handles various return types and converts them to a standardized McpSchema.ReadResourceResult format.
items.translation: 该方法可处理各种返回类型，并将其转换为标准化的 `McpSchema.ReadResourceResult` 格式。
